scope: Implement the proven GTK2 normal horizontal stepper corner correction using the active trough underlay and current KDE semantic colors

basis.gtk_source: GTK+ 2.24.33 GtkRange allocates horizontal stepper paint cells at 15x11; draw_stepper clips to that allocation.
basis.r360: The active trough is painted beneath the steppers and owns the four outer 15px bands.
basis.r362: The 9-slice preserves source columns 0..3 and 20..23 at native size.
basis.r363: Editing the stretched center produces repeated bands and was rejected.
basis.r364: An isolated normal-state probe using a 4px horizontal trough border and four role-derived corner samples matched both reference cells.

implementation.color_policy: Pixels are copied after rendering from stepper assets adapted to the current KDE palette; no fixed final RGB values are introduced.

visual_evidence.method: Direct RGB comparison at native size. Reference cells at x=2 and x=526, y=4; probe cells at x=2 and x=526, y=0. No scaling or displacement search.

validation.specific_regression: The derived pixels track changed KDE button-background roles after palette refresh.

limits: This proves only normal horizontal stepper corner pixels in the isolated GTK2 probe; it does not close pressed, hover, disabled, or vertical states.
The change was not installed into the user's profile and no application was restarted.
No input was sent to the Domain/OS VM in this step; the reference crop is the already verified live SR10.4 capture from R352.
No human visual acceptance is inferred.
next: Continue I167 GTK2 with remaining scrollbar states and orientations, then request the user's visual review in the already authorized environment before considering profile installation.
